title: Phase 2: make godot-stagehand usable as a beta
description:
Scope the next phase beyond the closed MVP beads. Goal: a developer can install the addon into a real Godot 4 project, configure an MCP client, launch/connect reliably, and use the core automation tools with documented examples and integration coverage.

Definition of done:
- README no longer says the project is unusable; it accurately describes beta capabilities and limitations.
- There is a verified quickstart from clean checkout to controlling a Godot test project through MCP.
- Phase 2 core tools from DESIGN.md are implemented or explicitly deferred with rationale.
- MVP tools have real Godot smoke coverage, not only mock WebSocket coverage.
- Remaining roadmap is represented by open beads rather than stale design prose.

title: Docs: beta quickstart, MCP client config, and addon install guide
description:
Replace the stale README status with practical beta documentation.

Acceptance criteria:
- README explains current implemented tools and explicitly marks missing Phase 2/3 features.
- Add a quickstart covering: build Go binary, copy/enable addons/stagehand in a Godot 4 project, run Godot with STAGEHAND_ENABLED=1 or --stagehand, configure an MCP client, call godot_connect and godot_get_tree.
- Include example MCP/client config snippets using absolute paths and placeholders.
- Include troubleshooting for port conflicts, addon not enabled, headless Godot, and connection failures.
- DESIGN.md roadmap is updated so it does not imply unimplemented tools are present.

title: Implement godot_launch with Godot process lifecycle management
description:
Implement the Phase 2 lifecycle tool promised by errors and DESIGN.md.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add MCP tool godot_launch with parameters for project_path, godot_bin, host/port, headless, extra_args, timeout_ms.
- Launch Godot with STAGEHAND_ENABLED=1 and STAGEHAND_PORT set, then wait for WebSocket ping readiness.
- Track the launched process and close/cleanup it when the MCP server exits or launches a replacement.
- Return structured launch result including pid, host, port, engine_version, stagehand_version.
- Existing godot_connect behavior remains unchanged for manual attach.
- Unit tests cover command construction and timeout/error paths; integration test covers headless launch when Godot is available.

title: Implement wait tools: godot_wait_for_node and godot_wait_for_property
description:
Add polling-based wait tools for common automation flows.

Acceptance criteria:
- GDScript handler supports wait_condition for node existence and property comparisons with timeout_ms and poll_interval_ms.
- MCP tools godot_wait_for_node and godot_wait_for_property are registered with schemas and useful error messages.
- Supported property operators include equals, not_equals, exists, contains, greater_than, less_than where type-appropriate.
- Timeouts return MCP tool errors with diagnostic context, not ambiguous JSON payloads.
- Tests cover success, timeout, invalid selector, and invalid property cases.

title: Implement scene and method tools: change_scene, call_method, evaluate
description:
Add the next set of high-leverage automation tools from DESIGN.md.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add GDScript command handlers for change_scene, call_method, and evaluate.
- Add MCP tools godot_change_scene, godot_call_method, and godot_evaluate with typed schemas.
- call_method resolves a selector to exactly one node unless an explicit allow_multiple option is supplied.
- evaluate is guarded/documented as dangerous and only works when Stagehand is explicitly enabled.
- Results and errors are JSON-safe and include enough detail to debug failures.
- Integration coverage exercises each tool against testdata/test_project.

title: Improve selectors: text:, meta:, unique:, and >> chaining
description:
Implement Phase 2 selector grammar so agents can target UI like Playwright locators.

Acceptance criteria:
- Go selector parser validates text:, meta:key=value, unique:, and chained selectors separated by >>.
- GDScript selector engine implements the same grammar and scopes chained matches to descendants of previous matches.
- Selector behavior is documented with examples and edge cases.
- Unit tests cover parser validation and GDScript behavior via integration/smoke tests.
- Existing path, name:, class:, and group: selectors remain backward compatible.

title: Add text input and mouse movement tools
description:
Round out basic input automation beyond click/key/action.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add MCP tools godot_type_text and godot_mouse_move.
- GDScript input simulator can send text input to the focused control and move mouse without clicking.
- godot_type_text supports delay_ms between characters and optional selector focus/click first.
- godot_mouse_move supports absolute coordinates and selector center targeting.
- Tests or documented manual smoke steps validate behavior in the test project.

title: Real Godot smoke tests for all MVP tools
description:
Expand confidence beyond the current ping/get_tree integration test.

Acceptance criteria:
- Headless integration tests cover find_nodes, get_property, set_property, screenshot, click, press_key, and press_action against testdata/test_project.
- Tests are skipped with a clear message when Godot is unavailable, and run automatically when GODOT_BIN/STAGEHAND_GODOT_BIN or godot is present.
- Test project includes minimal nodes/scripts needed to observe input and property changes.
- Failures print Godot logs and last JSON-RPC response for debugging.
close_reason: Merged real Godot smoke tests worktree

title: Normalize error handling across GDScript, GWP, and MCP tools
description:
Current handlers often return dictionaries with an error field, which can look like successful MCP tool calls. Make failures consistent and agent-friendly.

Acceptance criteria:
- Define canonical GWP error shape and mapping to JSON-RPC error responses.
- GDScript command_router catches handler errors and emits JSON-RPC errors where appropriate.
- Go MCP layer maps Godot errors to isError tool results with method, selector, and actionable detail.
- Tests cover disconnected state, missing handler, invalid selector, missing node, bad property, and timeout.

title: Package addon and release artifacts for beta use
description:
Make it easy to consume the project without manually discovering files.

Acceptance criteria:
- Document or script how to copy addons/stagehand into another Godot project.
- Build artifacts are named and versioned consistently for Linux/macOS/Windows where practical.
- Add a minimal example project or examples/ directory showing Stagehand enabled.
- Add release checklist covering Go build, tests, addon copy, README quickstart smoke test, and version bump.

Set up the Go module (go.mod), directory structure per DESIGN.md, and a CLAUDE.md with project conventions.

Directories:
- internal/mcpserver/
- internal/godotconn/
- internal/selector/
- addons/playwright/autoload/
- addons/playwright/core/
- addons/playwright/protocol/
- testdata/test_project/

Also: main.go stub, .gitignore, CLAUDE.md with build/test/lint commands.
title: Project scaffolding: Go module, directory structure, CLAUDE.md

description:
Implement screenshot_capture.gd:

- Capture viewport as PNG, base64 encode
- Support optional crop rect (from selector node's rect)
- Must await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw before capture
- Wire up as 'screenshot' command handler

Returns base64 PNG string.
title: GDScript: screenshot capture

description:
Implement tools_visual.go:

- godot_screenshot: forward to GWP screenshot, optional selector for crop
- Return as MCP ImageContent (base64 PNG) per MCP spec for image responses
- full_page parameter support
title: Go: MCP tools - godot_screenshot
Integration test: launch Godot headless, ping, get_tree
description:
Create testdata/test_project/ with a minimal Godot project and test scene. Write a Go integration test that:

1. Launches Godot headlessly with the playwright addon enabled
2. Connects via WebSocket
3. Sends ping, validates response
4. Calls get_tree, validates scene structure

This validates the full stack end-to-end. Requires Godot binary available in PATH or configured.

Implement tools_lifecycle.go and tools_navigation.go:

- godot_connect: establish WebSocket to running Godot game, send ping, return engine info
- godot_get_game_state: forward to GWP get_game_state, return current_scene, fps, physics_ticks, window_size, connected, engine_version

These are the first tools an agent calls to establish connection.
title: Go: MCP tools - godot_connect + godot_get_game_state

description:
Write Go tests that exercise the full MCP flow without a real Godot instance:

- In-memory MCP transport (no stdio)
- Mock WebSocket server that simulates GWP responses
- Test: connect -> get_tree -> find_nodes -> get_property -> screenshot flow
- Validates MCP tool schemas, error handling for disconnected state

Fast tests that run in CI without Godot.
title: End-to-end MCP test with mock Godot WebSocket

description:
Implement internal/selector/:

- parse.go: parse selector strings (path, name:, class:, group: prefixes)
- Validate syntax before sending to Godot
- parse_test.go: unit tests for all selector types, edge cases, invalid inputs

This validates on the Go side before the selector reaches GDScript.
title: Go: selector parser + validation

description:
Implement selector_engine.gd with MVP selector types:

- Exact node path (no prefix): get_node()
- name: prefix: recursive find_child() with glob matching
- class: prefix: tree walk + is_class()
- group: prefix: get_nodes_in_group()

Parse selector strings, resolve to arrays of matching nodes. Phase 2 adds text:, meta:, and >> chaining.
title: GDScript: selector engine (path, name, class, group)

description:
Implement tools_property.go:

- godot_get_property: selector + property name -> value and type
- godot_set_property: selector + property + value -> success and previous_value

Both forward to corresponding GWP methods.
title: Go: MCP tools - godot_get_property + godot_set_property

description:
Implement tools_query.go:

- godot_get_tree: forward to GWP get_tree with root_path, max_depth, include_properties params
- godot_find_nodes: forward to GWP query_nodes with selector, properties, limit params

Return structured JSON results.
title: Go: MCP tools - godot_get_tree + godot_find_nodes

description:
Command handlers for property access:

- get_property: resolve selector to node, read property (support dot notation like position.x), return value and type
- set_property: resolve selector, write property, return success and previous_value

Handle errors: node not found, property doesn't exist, type mismatch.
title: GDScript: get_property / set_property handlers

description:
Implement internal/mcpserver/server.go:

- MCP server over stdio using an MCP Go library
- Register all MVP tools with their schemas
- Wire tool handlers to godotconn.Connection
- Tools called before connection return isError with helpful message

Entry point: main.go with CLI flags for port, host.
title: Go: MCP server setup + tool registration

description:
Implement tools_input.go:

- godot_click: selector or position, button type, double_click
- godot_press_key: key name, modifiers, hold_ms
- godot_press_action: action name, strength, hold_ms

Forward to corresponding GWP input methods.
title: Go: MCP tools - godot_click + godot_press_key + godot_press_action

description:
Implement the core Godot addon infrastructure:

- plugin.cfg and plugin.gd (editor plugin with toolbar toggle)
- playwright_server.gd autoload: WebSocket server on port 26700
- json_rpc.gd: JSON-RPC 2.0 message parsing/construction
- command_router.gd: route incoming methods to handler functions
- Activation guard: only start when PLAYWRIGHT_ENABLED=1 or --playwright flag

This is the foundation all GDScript handlers build on.
title: GDScript addon: WebSocket server + JSON-RPC protocol layer

description:
Implement input_simulator.gd with methods to synthesize InputEvent objects:

- input_action: InputEventAction with action name and strength
- input_mouse: InputEventMouseButton at coordinates (left/right/middle, double-click)
- input_key: InputEventKey with keycode and modifiers
- hold_ms support via timer-based release

Wire up as command handlers: input_action, input_mouse, input_key.
title: GDScript: input simulator (action, mouse, key)

description:
Implement internal/godotconn/:

- conn.go: WebSocket connection with multiplexed JSON-RPC calls. Each in-flight call gets unique ID and response channel.
- protocol.go: GWP message types (Request, Response), JSON-RPC helpers
- reconnect.go: reconnection with exponential backoff (100ms -> 5s cap), state machine (Disconnected/Connecting/Connected/Reconnecting)

Connection states and transitions per DESIGN.md. Pending waits cancelled on reconnect. Tool calls queue for up to 3s during reconnect then fail.
title: Go: WebSocket connection manager (godotconn package)

description:
Implement tree_serializer.gd and wire up command handlers for:

- get_tree: serialize scene tree to JSON-safe dicts with name, class, path, children, optional properties. Respect max_depth.
- query_nodes: use selector engine to find matching nodes, return serialized results with requested properties and count. Respect limit param.
title: GDScript: tree serializer + get_tree/query_nodes handlers
